name: Step-through animator
description: Walk readers through an algorithm one step at a time.
long: A stepped diagram with ◀ PREV / ▶ PLAY / NEXT ▶ controls. Pick a preset: hash matching (audio fingerprint lookup, each hit votes for a song offset) or sliding window (LZ77 finds the longest earlier match). The same plugin is reused across topics with different data.
author: specimen-community
